Passive - Favor: 
Devotion: When near allied heroes, does not share Gold and EXP from minions and creep, but gains 35% Gold and EXP independently. Revealing enemies also grants Gold and EXP.
 A maximum of 2000 Gold can be gained through this skill. (Only triggers when you have the lowest Gold among all heroes with active Roaming Blessing on your team).
Thriving: Unique in Team: Gain 6 Gold and 12 EXP every 5s. After 8 minutes into the match, gain an additional 66% boost (only triggers when you have the lowest Gold among all heroes with active Roaming Blessing on your team).
Blessing: Accumulate 1000 Gold via Devotion and Thriving to unlock a skill.
During the first 5 minutes, Minion rewards are reduced to 50% when earned alone. After 2 minutes, Roaming Blessing can no longer be enchanted.
